lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's sixteen? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 16? Nope!

lines.text: Twenty-five dots, one unit apart in rows and columns.
lines.caption: 25 dots, 1 unit apart in rows and columns.

lines.text: How many pairs of dots are exactly five units apart?
lines.caption: How many pairs of dots are exactly 5 units apart?

lines.text: A row of five dots is only four units long. So the pair must be on a slant!
lines.caption: A row of 5 dots is only 4 units long. So the pair must be on a slant!

lines.text: Three across and four down makes a three, four, five triangle.
lines.caption: 3 across and 4 down makes a 3-4-5 triangle.

lines.text: It fits in two spots, side by side.
lines.caption: It fits in 2 spots, side by side.

lines.text: Point it right or left, and swap the three and four. That's four slants!
lines.caption: Point it right or left, and swap the 3 and 4. That's 4 slants!

lines.text: Four slants, two spots each. That's eight pairs!
lines.caption: 4 slants, 2 spots each. That's 8 pairs!

lines.text: Sixteen was the trap. It counts every pair twice.
lines.caption: 16 was the trap. It counts every pair twice.

lines.text: Did you get eight? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 8? Tell me below!
